svg.title: Mitra - classifier
svg.desc: AutoGluon - one stack, attending across rows and across features · 75.7 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; S: support rows; Q: query rows; F: features; D: model width (512). Abbreviations: MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: each table: training rows above, test rows below, columns across; attention across rows, within a column; the arrow points from the test rows to the training rows they read; attention across columns or features, within a row; outlined cells: an embedding, where every cell becomes a vector; the prediction for the test rows; × N: the block is stacked N times; right columns: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count.
svg.text: AutoGluon - one stack, attending across rows and across features · 75.7 M parameters
numeric matrix; the preprocessor mean-imputes first
999 quantiles of the support column; query values bucketed against them; no
a learned vector per class, plus one "unknown" for the query rows; prepended
pre-norm; 4 heads of 128; two attentions, two MLPs of 512 -> 2048
10 slots; softmax over the classes seen
keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads)
